Lying in ruins, the once-prominent '''Rebel Space Station''' was the base of operations for most [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] activity in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]].

==History==
At the height of the glory of the Alliance, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] suffocated any hope of survival. Only a carcass of the Rebel Space Station remained and, floating around it, memories of war in the form of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE]] and [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wing]] debris. Following this conflict, the the area was simply referred to as '''Rebel Ruins'''.
